# Scrolling: SU, SD, IND, RI, NEL, LF and DECSTBM. Most cases start from
# five lines a..e, which leave the cursor at 5,2.

=== SU scrolls the screen up
source: esctest2 su.py test_SU_ExplicitParam
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2S
cursor: 5,2
screen:
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== SU larger than the screen clears it
source: esctest2 su.py test_SU_CanClearScreen
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[99S
screen:
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== SU respects the scroll region
source: esctest2 su.py test_SU_RespectsTopBottomScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[S
screen:
|a.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|..........|
|e.........|

=== SU of the full screen feeds the scrollback
source: xterm scrollback behaviour; Alacritty grid scroll_up
scrollback: 10
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2S
history: 2

=== SU inside a region keeps the scrollback empty
source: xterm scrollback behaviour (only lines leaving the top of the screen are saved)
scrollback: 10
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[2S
history: 0
cursor: 1,1

=== SD scrolls the screen down
source: esctest2 sd.py test_SD_ExplicitParam
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2T
screen:
|..........|
|..........|
|a.........|
|b.........|
|c.........|

=== SD respects the scroll region
source: esctest2 sd.py test_SD_RespectsTopBottomScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[T
screen:
|a.........|
|..........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|e.........|

=== SD larger than the screen clears it
source: esctest2 sd.py test_SD_CanClearScreen
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[99T
screen:
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== IND moves down and keeps the column
source: esctest2 ind.py test_IND_Basic
input: \e[1;3H\eD
cursor: 2,3

=== IND at the bottom scrolls
source: esctest2 ind.py test_IND_Scrolls
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\eD
cursor: 5,2
screen:
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|

=== IND at the bottom margin scrolls the region
source: esctest2 ind.py test_IND_ScrollsInTopBottomRegionStartingWithin
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[4;1H\eD
cursor: 4,1
screen:
|a.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|..........|
|e.........|

=== IND below the region stops at the bottom line
source: esctest2 ind.py test_IND_StopsAtBottomLineWhenBegunBelowScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;3r\e[5;1H\eD
cursor: 5,1
screen:
|a.........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|

=== RI moves up and keeps the column
source: esctest2 ri.py test_RI_Basic
input: \e[3;3H\eM
cursor: 2,3

=== RI at the top scrolls down
source: esctest2 ri.py test_RI_Scrolls
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[1;1H\eM
cursor: 1,1
screen:
|..........|
|a.........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|

=== RI at the top margin scrolls the region
source: esctest2 ri.py test_RI_ScrollsInTopBottomRegionStartingWithin
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[2;1H\eM
screen:
|a.........|
|..........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|e.........|

=== RI above the region stops at the top line
source: esctest2 ri.py test_RI_StopsAtTopLineWhenBegunAboveScrollRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[3;4r\e[1;1H\eM
cursor: 1,1
screen:
|a.........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|

=== NEL moves to the start of the next line
source: esctest2 nel.py test_NEL_Basic
input: \e[1;5H\eE
cursor: 2,1

=== NEL at the bottom scrolls
source: esctest2 nel.py test_NEL_Scrolls
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\eE
cursor: 5,1
screen:
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|

=== LF at the bottom margin scrolls the region
source: esctest2 lf.py test_LF_ScrollsInTopBottomRegionStartingWithin; decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_ScrollsOnNewline
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;4r\e[4;1H\n
cursor: 4,1
screen:
|a.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|..........|
|e.........|

=== LF below the region does not scroll
source: esctest2 decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_NewlineBelowRegion
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;3r\e[5;1H\n
cursor: 5,1
screen:
|a.........|
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|

=== DECSTBM moves the cursor home
source: esctest2 decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_MovsCursorToOrigin
input: \e[3;4H\e[2;4r
cursor: 1,1

=== DECSTBM with top not above bottom is ignored
source: esctest2 decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_TopBelowBottom
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[3;3r\e[5;1H\n
cursor: 5,1
screen:
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|

=== DECSTBM with no parameters restores the full screen
source: esctest2 decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_DefaultRestores
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;3r\e[r\e[5;1H\n
screen:
|b.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|

=== DECSTBM clamps the bottom to the screen
source: esctest2 decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_MaxSizeOfRegionIsPageSize
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;99r\e[5;1H\n
screen:
|a.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|

=== DECSTBM with a zero top means the top of the screen
source: esctest2 decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_TopOfZeroIsTopOfScreen
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[0;3r\e[3;1H\n
screen:
|b.........|
|c.........|
|..........|
|d.........|
|e.........|

=== DECSTBM with a zero bottom means the bottom of the screen
source: esctest2 decstbm.py test_DECSTBM_BottomOfZeroIsBottomOfScreen
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\r\nd\r\ne\e[2;0r\e[5;1H\n
screen:
|a.........|
|c.........|
|d.........|
|e.........|
|..........|
